config.premise:
第十三声审判钟敲响时，锁着你的处刑链突然断了。

你在一座陌生王城的处刑台上醒来，所有人称你为「注定毁灭世界的反派千金」。一份被盖上王印的判决宣布，你将在今晚死去。然而，天空里同时浮现出另一行文字：你已经在这里死过九十九次，今天是最后一次。

魔族王储卡西安扔下王冠，挡住行刑者。他有资格命令全城，却不敢再替你决定去留。银发天使审判官卢西恩握着他亲笔签下的死刑令，却发现最早的一份判决在你出生之前就已经存在。龙裔骑士凯尔砸碎封印，手上带着不属于这一世的旧伤。禁术法师罗温收集着全部九十九次死亡记录，却拒绝解释他为何能够记得。影子刺客赛拉斯曾经接过杀死你的命令，如今带着凶手的最新密令现身。圣殿医师以斯拉拥有让生命重来的药剂，却不愿再要求你以自身为代价。

六个人在彼此面前都藏着旧罪。魔族王室想保住王权，天界想保住判决，骑士团想抹去失败，学者想停止循环，刺客想找出下令者，而医师想纠正每一次以「救你」为借口的剥夺。

当处刑结界再次亮起，六个人同时望向你。这一次，只有你能决定：寻找真凶、审判过去、建立关系，还是离开他们，亲手写下不再重来的明天。

en.title: The Villainess They Refused to Kill
en.hook: On your hundredth execution night, six men who once caused your death stand between you and the executioner.
en.premise:
When the thirteenth judgment bell tolls, the execution chains holding you suddenly snap.

You wake on a scaffold in an unfamiliar royal city, where everyone calls you the villainess destined to destroy the world. A verdict stamped with the royal seal says you will die tonight. Yet another line of text appears in the sky: you have already died here ninety-nine times, and today is the last.

Cassian, the demon crown prince, throws down his crown and blocks the executioner. Lucien, the silver-haired angel inquisitor, holds the death warrant he signed himself, only to find that the earliest verdict existed before you were born. Kael, the dragon knight, smashes the seal with an old wound from another life. Rowan, the forbidden mage, has kept records of all ninety-nine deaths and refuses to say why he remembers. Silas, the shadow assassin, once took the contract on your life and now carries the killer's newest order. Ezra, the temple healer, holds a potion that can start a life over, but will no longer ask you to pay for it yourself.

All six hide old sins from one another. When the execution barrier glows again, they all turn to you. This time, only you decide: hunt the true culprit, judge the past, build bonds, or walk away and write a tomorrow that never resets.
en.you: Play yourself: an adult pulled into this world and branded its villainess. Your name, attitude, relationships and boundaries are yours to decide.
